blocks.t: 1.2 Combining Functions; Shifting and Scaling Graphs
In this section we look at the main ways functions are combined or transformed to form new functions.

Like numbers, functions can be added, subtracted, multiplied, and divided (except where the denominator is zero) to produce new functions.
